t: Carbide grade with innovative tip design and optimised milled flute for fast, accurate drilling in all types of masonry. Copper brazing withstands high temperatures. Three milled clamping surfaces prevent slippage of the drill bit in the chuck. Suitable for fast drilling of plug, anchor or clearance holes in masonry, stone, concrete and brick and block work.
b: Suitable for Masonry, Stone, Concrete, Brick & Blockwork
